description: The tools, schemas, descriptions and outputs an agent works through. It deserves the same design care as a human user interface.
The text the model reads to decide whether and how to call a tool: what it does, what it returns, when to use it and when not to.

term: Schema as single source of truth
description: One schema (here Zod) both validates arguments at runtime and generates the JSON Schema shown to the model.
An error returned as tool output, naming the invalid field or missing entity and suggesting the next step, so the model can retry correctly.
Returning only the fields the next decision needs. Extra fields cost tokens, distract the model and can leak internal data.
An explicit `truncated` flag, total count and hint when results were cut, so the model knows it is not seeing everything.
A tool that can be called twice with the same arguments without a second effect. Models retry, so write tools should accept an idempotency key.
